body:
Commit e348c64. Founder: "next episode." Continued NEVER_LAND directly from E1 cliffhanger. Real, load-bearing crossover found and used rather than inventing new lore in isolation: identified NLE01 crow-wing wall-panel imagery as hero #68 in multiverse_heroes.md, The Morrigan Once Refused (seed phrase "refused once, present ever since," her own real Washer at the Ford aspect). Introduces the Archivist: the Morrigan herself, operating inside Academy custody, found washing something clean instead of the usual blood, for Tyler who has not died yet. The Man returns to force Hana own custody-assessment deadline; under pressure she discloses Tyler is the only thing she ever wanted that was not assigned to her. Tyler own act of looking confirmed as the debt real billing mechanism, a direct mechanism given to his pre-existing Green classification from E1. Episode ends with Tyler and Hana pushing together through an unmarked exit door into light that is not weather -- the literal first attempt at E1 own closing vow to run. Writer Room Rule 1 checked: Tyler completes no self-defining sentence. EPISODES.md/activity.md/CHANGELOG.md updated.

⚓ ☃
title: NEVER_LAND E2 'The Washer' written — real crossover with the existing Morrigan hero entry
